descriptions.w3d_f1a_scaled_vector_query_800b0788: Scales a caller-provided three-float vector by the ratio of the original constants at 0x803823ac and 0x803823a8, builds a vector from the constant at 0x803823a4, forwards both vectors with the caller object and integer arguments 1000 and 1 to 0x800b0824, then returns whether the unsigned global at 0x804b1764 is at most 1000. External data ownership is not claimed.
